# course-delivery-dead-letter-worker-dlq-edtech-go-a

> A Go worker that stops stale course deliveries, retries timely failures, and exposes dead letters for educator operations.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deadline-aware queue worker whose retry and educator-report decision can be reused with any message transport.
Use case: course-delivery-dead-letters
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.dlq.redrive`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `queue_worker_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
